Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing voter review of duplicate ballots.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to duplication of ballots; and adding a new sectionto chapter 29A.60 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: After certification of an election, any registered voter isauthorized to review duplicated ballots. In order to review theballots, a written request must be made to the county auditor withinthirty days of the certification of election. The ballots may not beremoved from the county office and may not be copied. The review mustbe done in the presence of at least two county employees designated bythe county auditor. The review must be conducted and completed withinninety days of the request. The duplicated ballots may not bedestroyed until the review is complete or ninety days has elapsed. Anyperson requesting a review under this section shall reimburse thecounty all expenses related to the review.
